repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly executes the valve close and email call in the periodic body (else branch) every cycle. The IR specifies a one-shot sequence (wait, then call) followed by an infinite cycle containing ONLY the email call. The candidate duplicates the pre-cycle actions, violating the IR structure.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the pre-cycle actions (valve close and email) from the `else` branch. The `if` branch now correctly handles the initial wait and valve close, while the `else` branch contains only the periodic email call as required by the IR.
